## Reading rules

- [ ] A missing unit, inner/outer label, or board is still left empty
- [ ] Quantity tiers are not added together
- [ ] Grayboard and MDF are not treated as the same board
- [ ] No price formula and no manufacturability approval

## Checks

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] English and Chinese strings updated together, if copy changed
- [ ] No customer enquiry, email address, or phone number in the diff
- [ ] No new network call, tracker, or storage
